sets._source: plan rev3 A2: comparison sites drawn at random among all sites except KB and O, R = 5 draws per A1 pair; nested in m (the first m sites of one seeded order), so every m uses the same draw (our choice)

partitions._source: plan rev3 A2: same m x 3,000 documents split into m groups of exactly 3,000: site (curated), tag clusters (balanced spherical k-means on the set's own tag TF-IDF, sparse; main cluster type; review 2026-10-06 replaced a global SVD-128 that kept <1% of the tag energy for half of the documents), cross-embedding clusters (contriever-msmarco embeddings; detector bge-m3), same-embedding clusters (bge-m3; reference for circularity), random equal split. Balanced k-means = k-means++ init (seeded), capacity-constrained greedy assignment in rounds, 15 iterations (our choices)
partitions._purity: per (pair, draw, m, partition): mean over groups of the majority-site share (review 2026-10-06: embedding clusters nearly reproduce sites on this test bed)

general._source: plan rev3 A2: general corpus with a different style, same size m x 3,000 (seeded sample of the 50k P9 pool per draw): pooled background, random split, cross-embedding (contriever) clusters
